topic.title: Link Bitbucket to Other Atlassian or External Apps Using OAuth 1.0
topic.shortdesc: Use this procedure to create an OAuth 1.0 application link between Bitbucket and another Atlassian product or an external application.

body.p: To link Bitbucket to another Atlassian product or an external application using OAuth 1.0, follow this procedure:

ol.li: Go to the Bitbucket server Administration page, click Application links, and then select Create link.

Select Atlassian product as the link type. This option also works for external applications. This is the original application links mechanism. It remains available under this option so that users can continue using their OAuth 1.0 integrations, as provided by Bitbucket.

Select the Application type (either Atlassian product or External application. Enter the URL of your Atlassian product or external application (e.g. enter the home page address of your Oxygen XML Web Author instance as the application URL).
When the Configure Application URL dialog box appears, confirm the URL, make sure it is correct, and click Continue.

In the resulting Link Applications dialog box, define a name for the application link to Web Author in the Application Name field. Make sure that the Application Type is set to Generic Application. Leave all other fields blank, and then click Continue.
The Configure Application Links page should display the new application link. Click the pencil icon under the Actions column to edit the application link.
Click the Incoming Authentication tab to configure the OAuth 1.0 parameters.

Enter a Consumer Key. It must be unique with respect to other application links and must be the same as the one you enter here. Next, enter a Consumer Name, the Public Key, and the Consumer Callback URL. Then click Save and Close.
